verdict.rationale: The California Franchise Tax Board is a state tax agency whose web surface covers filing and payments (MyFTB, Web Pay). It is not a platform where users build automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence pack only records edge denials (HTTP 403) and contains nothing suggesting an automation-building capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
